scientific_native_core.locator: official v3 original model Fig3 and behavior tests

scientific_native_core.locator: original v3 fMRI and ROI Fig4-6
scientific_native_core.claim: dLPFC reported encoding of joint expected task; proactive demand is derived from prior task vs predicted task, reactive demand from prior estimate vs actual task; differential network encoding patterns do NOT establish unique causal implementation or source-reweighting neural mechanism

Joint PE encoding in dorsal medial prefrontal cortex and separate prediction representations rely on multivariate regressors/ROI; cross-validated classification and confounds require original specific negative conditions retained
